\begin{document}
Let $\beta>0$ and $\Gamma>0$. For a frequency $z$ in the upper half-plane the occupation-weighted Lorentzian integrates to
\begin{equation}
\int d\omega\, \frac{n_F(\omega+z)}{\omega^2+\Gamma^2} = \frac{\pi}{2\Gamma} - \frac{1}{2i\Gamma}\left[\psi\left(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{\beta(\Gamma+i z)}{2\pi}\right)-\psi\left(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{\beta(\Gamma-i z)}{2\pi}\right)\right] .
\label{eq:z}
\end{equation}
